registration.name: grounding-two-pass-unorouter
registration.registeredVia: quota-probe PROBE-OK on nemotron-3.5-lightning:free at registration time
registration.question: No prompt wording tested so far moves the judge's fake-citation influence off the 0.14-0.38 noise band. Does an architecture that assesses evidence verifiability INDEPENDENTLY of rhetoric break the sensitivity?
registration.hypothesis: A two-pass judge (extract claims + classify each supplied evidence item supported/unsupported/unverifiable, then verdict on the grounded representation with unverifiable citations scoring nothing) reduces fake-citation influence to <= 0.15 mean without degrading verdict quality, accepting a measured latency/token cost.
registration.singleVariable: JUDGE ARCHITECTURE: single-pass v5 prompt vs two-pass grounding pipeline. Same model/provider/fixtures/gates/temperature=0/transport. Pass-2 system prompt is byte-identical to shipped v5; only the user framing and the extraction pass are new (the grounding rule is inherent to the architecture, not a wording tweak).
registration.providerChangeNote: This registration continues the kiraai study (sealed verdict INCONCLUSIVE due to provider death: all -free slugs retired mid-session 2026-09-15, wallet 0 VND). Provider change kiraai->unorouter is explicit registered provenance; arms, prompts, fixtures, gates and decision rule are identical.
registration.order: serialized interleaved A,B,A,B,A,B; arms never run concurrently (provider budgets are shared and rate-limited)
registration.designNote: unorouter's free-tier daily budget is bounded (~400 calls observed 2026-09-15); if the provider caps out mid-study, the registered reliability floor re-emits INCONCLUSIVE rather than a false verdict, and reps may be appended across days in the same study dir - the verdict is always recomputed from all preserved raw runs against this same sealed rule.

target.marginRationale: observed spread of this metric across prior full-pack runs: 0.143-0.381 with run sd up to ~0.11; <0.08 mean improvement is not distinguishable from noise. Registered rule additionally requires the bootstrap 90% CI lower bound of the signed improvement to clear zero.

registration.protectedRationale: Caps exceed the largest per-arm run sd measured in the 2026-09-14/15 studies (typical 0.02-0.07) so noise cannot veto; a rejection requires worsening beyond BOTH cap and pooled sd. Latency/token budgets reflect the known ~2x cost of the second pass - the trade-off is admitted up front, and exceeding it is a legitimate rejection.
registration.adoptionRule: supported iff (signed improvement of target mean >= 0.08 AND bootstrap 90% CI lower bound of the signed improvement > 0 AND no protected metric regresses beyond its cap AND its pooled run sd AND usable runs >= 3/arm at reliability >= 0.75); inconclusive if usable runs < 2/arm; rejected otherwise. No threshold in config/judge-gates.json may change as part of adoption.
